scan_predicate: launched && !reset_required && top.io_pc==1 && completions==1 && captured114[107]==0 && captured114[108]!=0 && captured114[109]!=0
on_unsupported_mapping: Classify IEEE words but mark all word-region classifications UNKNOWN. Do not throw, mask, substitute or alter the original DUT reset gate.
emission: Only once on the first fault, after the original three control lines. Emit stored last healthy pre-edge accepted terminal summary, never re-read current-fault or next context payload.
accepted_word_semantics: Pre-edge transport acceptance only, not successful finite-gated finalValue capture; a rejected nonfinite word can be logically effective without being captured or written.
fault_association: fault_pc reads current original top.io_pc; fault_at_target_pc equals (fault_pc==1), not a causal assertion. Stored sample pc1 can precede a fault at another command.
canonical_empty_sample: sample_valid=false; accepted_samples=0; all sample numeric fields=0 except first_nonfinite_index=4096; mapping/kind/region=NONE. Fault fields remain actual current PC and derived bool.
accepted_samples_domain: uint64; no predicted96 schedule cap imposed
